situations.headline: NEXTDC launches A$1.1bn convertible notes to fund data centre pipeline

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: NEXTDC launches A$1.1bn convertible notes to fund data centre pipeline (interest 4, risk 3)

thesis.text: NEXTDC continues to fund its AI/hyperscale-driven Australian data centre buildout via diversified, low-cash-cost capital instruments (senior debt, hybrid securities, subordinated notes, and now converts), preserving balance-sheet flexibility while extending liquidity runway to ~A$9.8bn pro forma; the convertible's capped call structure limits near-term dilution economics up to a 70% premium, making this primarily a growth-financing event rather than a re-rating catalyst, with future announcements on pipeline contracting and utilisation being the key value drivers to monitor.
